pois.name: LU Botāniskais Dārzs
pois.nameEnglish: Botanical Garden of the University of Latvia
pois.intro: University of Latvia Botanical Garden is botanical garden in Riga, Latvia. It is the oldest botanical garden in Latvia.

pois.name: Better Bread
pois.address: 7 Pulkveža Brieža iela, Rīga, LV-1010, LV

pois.name: Brīvības piemineklis
pois.intro: The Freedom Monument is a monument located in Riga, Latvia, honouring soldiers killed during the Latvian War of Independence. It is considered an important symbol of the freedom, independence, and sovereignty of Latvia.

pois.name: Rīgas Pils
pois.intro: Riga Castle is a castle on the banks of River Daugava in Riga, the capital of Latvia. The castle was founded in 1330.

pois.name: Svētā Pētera baznīca
pois.intro: St. Peter's Church (Latvian: Svētā Pētera evaņģēliski luteriskā baznīca, German: St.

pois.name: Melngalvju nams
pois.intro: The House of the Blackheads is a building situated in the old town of Riga, Latvia. The original building was erected in 1334 as a warehouse, meeting and celebration place for merchants.

pois.name: Centrāltirgus
pois.intro: Riga Central Market is Europe's largest market and bazaar in Riga, Latvia. It is one of the most notable structures from the 20th century in Latvia and has been included in the UNESCO World Heritage Site list together with Old Riga in 1998.

pois.name: Latvijas Nacionālais vēstures muzejs
pois.intro: The Latvian National Museum of History, is a national history museum in Riga, Latvia. It was founded in 1869 by the Riga Latvian Society.

pois.name: Rīgas Nacionālais Zooloģiskais dārzs
pois.intro: Riga Zoo is a city-owned zoo in Riga, Latvia. It is located in Mežaparks neighbourhood next to the Mežaparks park, on the western bank of Ķīšezers lake.

pois.name: Kaķu nams
pois.intro: The Cat House is a building situated at 10 Meistaru iela in the old town of Riga, the capital of Latvia. It was built in 1909 according to the blueprint of architect Friedrich Scheffel.

pois.name: Rīgas vēstures un kuģniecības muzejs
pois.nameEnglish: Museum of the history of Riga and navigation
pois.intro: Museum of the History of Riga and Navigation is housed by the Riga Dom Cathedral ensemble in the heart of the Old Riga, Latvia. It originated in 1773 as a private collection of Nikolaus von Himsel, a Riga doctor.

pois.name: Rīgas Horālā sinagoga
pois.intro: The Great Choral Synagogue was a Jewish congregation and synagogue, that was located on Gogoļa iela, in the Latgale neighborhood of Riga, Latvia. Designed by Paul von Hardenack in predominately Renaissance Revival style, the synagogue was completed in 1871.

pois.name: Rīgas Lielie kapi
pois.intro: The Great Cemetery was formerly the principal cemetery of Riga in Latvia, established in 1773. It was the main burial ground of the Baltic Germans in Latvia.

pois.name: Svētā Jura baznīca
pois.intro: St. George's Church used to be a Catholic church in Riga, the capital of Latvia.

pois.name: Vērmanes dārzs
pois.intro: Vērmane Garden is the oldest public garden in the city of Riga, Latvia, and currently comprises an area of approximately 5 hectares. The current name is a Latvian transliteration of the garden's original German name.

pois.name: Latvijas Arhitektūras muzejs
pois.address: 19 Mazā Pils iela, Rīga, LV-1050, LV
pois.intro: The Latvian Museum of Architecture is a museum in Riga, Latvia. It is housed in an old medieval building which is part of the Three Brothers and belongs to the Latvian Museum Association.

pois.name: Jews in Latvia
pois.intro: The Jews in Latvia Museum is in Riga, Latvia. The main tasks of the museum are the research and popularisation of the history of the Jews in Latvia and the collection and preservation of evidence regarding the community of Latvian Jews from its beginning.

pois.name: Latvijas Nacionālais dabas muzejs
pois.nameEnglish: Latvian National Museum of Natural History
pois.address: 4 Krišjāņa Barona iela, Rīga, LV-1050, LV
pois.intro: The Latvian National Museum of Natural History is a natural history museum in Riga, Latvia. It was founded in 1845 as the Riga Naturalist Society.

pois.name: Dekoratīvās mākslas un dizaina muzejs
pois.nameEnglish: Museum of Decorative Arts and Design
pois.intro: The Latvian Museum of Decorative Arts and Design is an arts museum in Riga, Latvia. The museum was established on 1 January 1989 and opened to the public on 6 July 1989.

pois.name: Farmācijas muzejs
pois.address: 13 Riharda Vāgnera iela, Rīga, LV-1050, LV
pois.intro: The Latvian Museum of Pharmacy is a medical museum in Riga, Latvia. It was founded in 1987 in association with the Pauls Stradins Museum for History of Medicine and is located on Richard Wagner street in an 18th-century building which itself is an architectural monument.

pois.name: Latvijas Fotogrāfijas muzejs
pois.intro: The Latvian Museum of Photography is the only memory institution in Latvia dedicated to the medium of photography. The museum offers a full range of research opportunities, including the collection, archives and library.

pois.name: Izstāžu zāle Arsenāls
pois.intro: Arsenāls – Fine Arts Museum is an art museum in Riga, Latvia, department of the Latvian National Museum of Art. The museum's collections include Baltic and Latvian art from the 18th century forward.

pois.name: Pauls Stradiņa Medicīnas vēstures muzejs
pois.nameEnglish: Paul Stradins Museum of the History of Medicine
pois.address: 1 Ukrainas neatkarības iela, Rīga, LV-1010, LV
pois.intro: Paul Stradins Museum of the History of Medicine is museum in Riga, one of the largest medical museums in the world. The exposition presents the development of medicine and pharmacology from ancient times.

pois.name: Stūra māja
pois.intro: The Corner House is a historic building in the city center of Riga, Latvia. It was known as the headquarters of the Soviet KGB in Latvia from 1940 to 1941 and from 1944 to 1991.

pois.name: Mencendorfa nams
pois.intro: Das Mentzendorffhaus ist ein historisches Wohn- und Geschäftshaus in Riga, das heute als Museum zugänglich ist.

pois.name: Doma laukums
pois.intro: La Place de la cathédrale est une place du quartier Vecpilseta à Riga en Lettonie.

pois.name: Laimas pulkstenis
pois.intro: The Laima Clock is a landmark in central Riga, Latvia. Its location between the Old Town and the Centre commercial district has made it a landmark of the city.

pois.intro: Olimpia , anciennement Olympia est un centre commercial situé dans le voisinage Ķīpsala du district de Kurzeme à Rīga en Lettonie.

pois.name: Galerija Centrs
pois.intro: Galerija Centrs is a shopping centre in Riga, Latvia. The centre opened in 1938 and presently occupies nearly an entire block in the historic Vecrīga neighborhood.

pois.name: Origo
pois.intro: Le centre commercial Origo est un centre commercial situé dans le district central de Rīga en Lettonie.

pois.name: Āgenskalna tirgus
pois.intro: Āgenskalns Market is the oldest marketplace on the left bank of Daugava in Riga. Āgenskalns Market’s building is one of the examples of 20th-century rational Art Nouveau.

pois.name: Domina Shopping
pois.intro: Domina Shopping est un centre commercial situé dans le voisinage de Teika.

pois.name: Bazaar
pois.address: 22 Pulkveža Brieža iela, Rīga, LV-1045, LV

pois.name: Kronvalda parks
pois.intro: Der Kronvalds Park, ursprünglich Strēlnieku dārzs, ist ein Teil der Grünanlagen des alten Rigaer Kanalufers. Der Stadtkanal teilt den Park in zwei Teile.

pois.name: Uzvaras parks
pois.intro: Victory Park is a park in Riga, located on the left bank of the Daugava, in the district of Āgenskalns. The modern area of the park is 36.7 hectares.

pois.name: Esplanāde
pois.intro: Die Esplanade ist eine weiträumige Parkanlage im östlichen Zentrum der lettischen Hauptstadt Riga. Der Platz wurde bis 1812 als Exerzierplatz der in Riga stationierten zaristischen Truppen benutzt, im Mittelalter lag dieser Bezirk außerhalb der Stadtbefestigung und war ein von Sanddünen durchzogenes Ödland.

pois.name: Bastejkalna parks
pois.intro: Bastejkalns Park is a spacious park on the northern edge of the old town of Latvian capital Riga.

pois.name: Viestura dārzs
pois.intro: Сад Вие́стура — современное название первого в истории Риги публичного сада, который в 1721 году был основан у границы города-крепости по распоряжению Петра I под названием Царского сада и в дальнейшем был известен как Петровский парк вплоть до реконструкции 1923 года, когда он был переименован в сад Виестура.

pois.name: Dzegužkalns
pois.intro: Le Dzegužkalns anciennement Jēru kalns est un parc public du voisinage de Dzirciems à Riga en Lettonie.

pois.name: Līvu laukums
pois.intro: La Place de Livonie est une place du quartier Vecpilseta à Riga en Lettonie.

pois.name: Aleksandra vārti
pois.intro: La Porte d'Alexandre est un monument classique construit sur le modèle des arcs de triomphe romains. Edifié de 1815 à 1817, il est situé dans le jardin Viestura dans la capitale de la Lettonie, Riga .
